import pathlib, json, hashlib, subprocess, os, ctypes, shutil, time, re, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
repo=pathlib.Path('C:/Users/Dan/Desktop/Projects/formal-pvnp')
root=repo/'certifications/realizable-hardness'
reports=repo/'research/p-equals-np'
outroot=root/'.lake/build/zoomout-parameters-independent-review-20260912'
lib=outroot/'lib/lean'
report=reports/'2026-09-12-realizable-hardness-zoomout-parameters-proof-verification.json'
candidate='881c5b882556534b7b34468f8b34c7db9358a04b'
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def digest(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
class MS(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('length',ctypes.c_ulong),('load',ctypes.c_ulong)]+[(x,ctypes.c_ulonglong) for x in ['total','avail','totalpage','availpage','totalvirtual','availvirtual','extended']]
def memory():
    m=MS(); m.length=ctypes.sizeof(m)
    assert ctypes.windll.kernel32.GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ctypes.byref(m))
    return m.avail
def readreport(n): return json.loads((reports/f'2026-09-12-realizable-hardness-{n}-proof-verification.json').read_bytes())
assert not outroot.exists(), 'Fresh root required'
assert sha(root/'lake-manifest.json')=='825d2e1a20005a259fdf5b181528b391dd6ba18a52c86127caf4c3be990e04f0'
manifest=json.loads((root/'lake-manifest.json').read_bytes()); pins=[]
for p in manifest['packages']:
    actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root/'.lake/packages'/p['name']),'rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip()
    assert actual==p['rev']; pins.append({'name':p['name'],'revision':actual})
assert len(pins)==11
lean=pathlib.Path('C:/Users/Dan/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.34.0-rc2/bin/lean.exe')
version=subprocess.check_output([str(lean),'--version']).decode().strip()
assert '6a10ac8c22beadecabdbb0919c2b50214762f91d' in version
env=os.environ.copy(); env['LEAN_NUM_THREADS']='1'; env['PYTHONUTF8']='1'
env['LEAN_PATH']=';'.join([str(lib)]+[str(root/'.lake/packages'/p['name']/'.lake/build/lib/lean') for p in pins]+[str(lean.parent.parent/'lib/lean')])
state={'schema':'independent-proof-v1','candidate_commit':candidate,'environment':{'LEAN_PATH':env['LEAN_PATH'],'LEAN_NUM_THREADS':'1','toolchain':version},'manifest_sha256':sha(root/'lake-manifest.json'),'dependency_pins':pins,'accepted_dependency_copies':[],'exports':[],'runner_source':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')}
base=readreport('good-advice')['accepted_dependency_copies']; assert len(base)==61
deps=[(x['module'],x['source'],x['sha256']) for x in base]
for sibling in ['gaussian-nearone','zoomout-incidence']:
    d=readreport(sibling)
    for x in d['exports']:
        assert x['exit_code']==0
        deps.append((x['module'],x['output'],x['output_sha256']))
assert len(deps)==65 and len(set(x[0] for x in deps))==65
lib.mkdir(parents=True)
for mod,src,expected in deps:
    src=pathlib.Path(src); assert sha(src)==expected,(mod,'source')
    dest=lib/pathlib.Path(*mod.split('.')).with_suffix('.olean'); dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(src,dest); assert sha(dest)==expected
    state['accepted_dependency_copies'].append({'module':mod,'source':str(src),'output':str(dest),'sha256':expected})
def save(): report.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False),encoding='utf-8')
names=['ZoomOutParameters','ZoomOutParametersChecks']
expected=['28b1901358bdbe3b4065ba7f124c35caaf1de3ed98541b633f730649f5873f69','434d058b5ff7724813dc4bac3dbb44eec13eefa439c33c3950326729bcae1482']
for name,hs in zip(names,expected):
    source=root/f'lean/PvNP/RealizableHardness/{name}.lean'; raw=source.read_bytes(); assert digest(raw)==hs
    rel=source.relative_to(repo).as_posix(); frozen=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'show',candidate+':'+rel])
    assert raw.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')==frozen.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
    text=raw.decode('utf-8'); assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|native_decide|axiom)\b',re.sub(r'/\-.*?\-/|--[^\n]*','',text,flags=re.S))
    pre=memory(); assert pre>=805306368; assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free>=805306368
    output=lib/f'PvNP/RealizableHardness/{name}.olean'; log=outroot/f'{name}-{time.time_ns()}.log'
    cmd=[str(lean),'-R','lean','-o',str(output),str(source)]
    with log.open('wb') as f:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        print('LIVE',name,proc.pid,str(log),flush=True)
        low=pre; stopped=False
        while proc.poll() is None:
            mem=memory(); low=min(low,mem)
            if mem<671088640 or shutil.disk_usage(root).free<671088640:
                proc.terminate(); stopped=True
            time.sleep(.25)
        rc=proc.wait()
    rec={'module':'PvNP.RealizableHardness.'+name,'source':str(source),'source_sha256':hs,'frozen_source_sha256':digest(frozen),'candidate_match_after_CRLF_normalization':True,'command':cmd,'exit_code':rc,'available_memory_before':pre,'minimum_available_memory':low,'guard_stopped':stopped,'log':str(log),'log_sha256':sha(log),'output':str(output),'output_sha256':sha(output) if rc==0 else None}
    log.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(rec,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    state['exports'].append(rec); save()
    rec['raw_log_utf8']=log.read_bytes().decode('utf-8'); save()
    print('ACTUAL_EXIT',name,rc,flush=True)
    if rc: sys.exit(rc)
    assert sha(source)==hs
    queries=re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)',text,re.M)
    profiles=re.findall(r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms: \[([^\]]*)\]",rec['raw_log_utf8'],re.S)
    assert len(profiles)==len(queries)
    for q,(full,ax) in zip(queries,profiles):
        assert full.endswith('.'+q)
        assert set(re.findall(r'[\w.]+',ax))<= {'propext','Classical.choice','Quot.sound'}
    rec['axiom_profiles']=profiles; rec['query_order']=queries; rec['examples']=len(re.findall(r'^example\b',text,re.M)); save()
state['total_axiom_profiles']=sum(len(x['axiom_profiles']) for x in state['exports'])
state['total_examples']=sum(x['examples'] for x in state['exports'])
assert state['total_axiom_profiles']==8 and state['total_examples']==8
state['runner_exit_code']=0; state['proof_verdict']='GO-WITH-NOTES'; save()
print('VERIFIED',sha(report),flush=True)
